settings.title: Settings
settings.nothing: Nothing on the home screen yet.
settings.hint.select: OK adds or removes an item · Hold OK to re-order · Back returns home
settings.hint.reorder: OK picks up an item · Hold OK or choose Done to finish
settings.hint.holding: Arrows move it · OK puts it down · Back cancels
settings.hint.options: OK changes a setting · ← → adjust numbers · Back returns home
prefs.theme.label: Theme
prefs.theme.description: OLED black keeps unused pixels off. Calm blue-grey is softer. Glass has frosted panels and tiles that lift when selected, like Apple TV.
prefs.glassTint.label: Glass colour
prefs.glassTint.description: The background and card colour of the Glass theme.
prefs.reduceEffects.label: Reduce effects (faster)
prefs.reduceEffects.description: No blur, shadows or springy motion. The look stays the same otherwise. Turn on if moving along the apps ever feels slow.
prefs.iconScale.label: Icon size
prefs.iconScale.description: Make the app icons smaller or bigger. ← → adjust.
prefs.rows.label: Rows of apps
prefs.rows.description: Show the apps in one row, or split over two rows (up/down moves between them).
prefs.showLabels.label: Show app names
prefs.showLabels.description: The name under each icon on the home row. Switch off for icons only.
prefs.sideMargin.label: Side margin
prefs.sideMargin.description: Space left and right of the app row. ← → adjust.
prefs.bottomMargin.label: Bottom margin
prefs.bottomMargin.description: Space below the app row. ← → adjust.
prefs.homeFocus.label: When Home is pressed
prefs.homeFocus.description: Which app is highlighted when you come back to Hearth.
prefs.quietAfter.label: Hide the apps when idle
prefs.quietAfter.description: After this long without a button press the app row fades out, leaving the clock, weather and wallpaper. Any button brings it back.
prefs.resetLook.label: Reset look and clock
prefs.resetLook.description: Theme, icon size, margins and clock back to their defaults.
prefs.clockFormat.label: Time format
prefs.clockFormat.description: 12-hour, 24-hour, or the same as the TV.
prefs.clockSize.label: Clock size
prefs.clockSize.description: How big the time is. ← → adjust.
prefs.clockFont.label: Clock font
prefs.clockFont.description: The typeface of the time and date. "TV font" is the TV's own; the others come with the launcher.
prefs.clockWeight.label: Clock thickness
prefs.clockTop.label: Clock position (vertical)
prefs.clockTop.description: How far down from the top of the screen (0% is the very top). ← → adjust.
prefs.clockLeft.label: Clock position (horizontal)
prefs.clockLeft.description: Move the clock left or right (50% is the centre). ← → adjust.
prefs.showDate.label: Show the date
prefs.showDate.description: The day and date under the time.
prefs.showPeriod.label: Show AM / PM
prefs.showPeriod.description: The small AM or PM beside the time (12-hour only).
prefs.clockCorner.label: In the top-left corner (Glass theme)
prefs.clockCorner.description: The clock and weather cards in the top-left corner. Clock size sets their size, as in the centre (they shrink by themselves if they would reach the apps). The position settings are not used.
prefs.clockShift.label: Move the clock slightly (OLED care)
prefs.clockShift.description: Every 3 minutes the clock moves a few pixels, too little to notice, so it never wears into the screen.
prefs.wallpaper.label: Wallpaper
prefs.wallpaper.description: A picture, or a folder of pictures for a slideshow, from a USB drive or the TV.
prefs.interval.label: Change picture every
prefs.interval.description: How long each picture stays up in a slideshow.
prefs.shuffle.label: Shuffle
prefs.shuffle.description: Random order. When off, pictures play A to Z.
prefs.clockColor.label: Widget colour (clock, date, weather)
prefs.clockColor.description: White is hard to read on a light picture. For light wallpapers pick a dark colour or one of the gradients; for dark ones the light colours look best.
prefs.clockOpacity.label: Widget opacity
prefs.clockOpacity.description: How solid the clock, date and weather are, from 10% to 100%. Lower it if a dark colour looks too heavy. ← → adjust.
prefs.closeHome.label: Close LG Home when the app opens
prefs.closeHome.description: Frees memory by ending the LG home app each time the launcher opens. Needs the Homebrew Channel. Turns itself off if LG Home keeps coming back.
prefs.useHomebrew.label: Live app list via Homebrew Channel
prefs.useHomebrew.description: Rooted TVs: every installed app with its real icon. Uses the Homebrew Channel, which runs commands as root.
prefs.useAsHome.label: Alternative method: use as the TV's home app (experimental, webOS 5)
prefs.useAsHome.description: Sets the TV's own home-app setting. May not work on webOS older than 5 (it did not on webOS 4).
prefs.replaceHome.label: Make this launcher the default instead of LG Home
prefs.replaceHome.description: A small background helper opens this launcher whenever LG Home comes to the front (Home, Back). Nothing is replaced. OK turns it on or off.
prefs.startAtBoot.label: Start the launcher helper at boot
prefs.startAtBoot.description: Adds a link in the TV's startup folder. Switch off to remove it; the helper then starts when this launcher opens.
prefs.tvInput.label: Add the launcher as a TV input (start the TV on it)
prefs.tvInput.description: Adds this launcher to the TV's input list, like HDMI 1. Then set the TV to start on its last input and pick this one: the TV boots straight into the launcher. OK adds or removes it.
prefs.lgLogo.label: Show the LG logo when the TV starts
prefs.lgLogo.description: LG's own switch (normally hidden): turn it off for a clean start straight into this launcher. OK turns it on or off.
prefs.homeButton.label: Home button opens Hearth directly
prefs.homeButton.description: LG Home is never shown when you press Home: no flash. Uses LG Input Hook (from the Homebrew Channel). Keep the helper above on for Back and start-up. OK turns it on or off.
prefs.key.button.description: An app of your choice opens when you press the {{name}} button, anywhere on the TV. Uses LG Input Hook. ← → or OK choose.
prefs.closeHomeNow.label: Close LG Home now
prefs.closeHomeNow.description: Ends it right away and shows how much memory that freed.
prefs.weatherOn.label: Show the weather
prefs.weatherOn.description: The temperature and conditions under the date.
prefs.weatherCity.label: City
prefs.weatherCity.description: Pick a city from the list, or search for any place by name. Needs an internet connection.
prefs.weatherUnit.label: Temperature unit
prefs.weatherCityName.label: Show the city name
prefs.weatherCityName.description: The city's name before the temperature.
prefs.weatherRange.label: Show today's high and low
prefs.weatherHours.label: Show the next hours
prefs.weatherHours.description: The next three hours under the temperature, in the Glass theme's weather card.
appMenu.uninstall.detail: Removes the app from the TV

appMenu.confirm.text: This removes the app from the TV.
appMenu.working.title: Uninstalling {{title}}…
appMenu.working.text: Please wait, this can take a few seconds.

picker.noUsbDetail: Plug one in, then open this screen again
picker.nothingHereDetail: This folder has no pictures or folders
picker.slideshow: Play this folder as a slideshow
picker.noPictures: No pictures found in that folder

picker.couldntShow: Couldn't show any picture from that location

cityPicker.hint.list: OK chooses a city · Back returns to settings
cityPicker.search.detail: Type its name with the on-screen keyboard

cityPicker.noMatch.detail: Try another spelling, or just the city's name

wallpaper.builtin.horizon.detail: A calm dark sky with a glowing horizon
